svg.aria-label: ai-pet-short-video-director turns a one-line idea into a story, a four-shot plan, and accept and stop rules before any paid generation (worked example)
svg.title: ai-pet-short-video-director: idea to story, shot plan, and accept/stop rules before paid generation (worked example)

g.text: > Pitch one 15-second video for my orange cat. No video prompt yet.
Story
Hook
Choice
Payoff
A tiny dog has fallen asleep across the whole warm mat.
The cat gives up its claim to cover the shivering dog with a cloth.
The dog wakes and makes room. Both share the mat.
Shot plan
End state
Cat, dog, mat and folded cloth in one locked view
Paw raised, stops; the cat grips the cloth edge
Cloth drawn over the dog; the dog shifts aside
The cat sits in the open spot; brief hold
cat sees the dog
cloth in its mouth
space on the mat
both on the mat
Before you spend credits
Accept the first take only if the cloth moves by visible mouth contact.
Stop if the cloth teleports or the dog moves first. Split the shot; don't buy more.
Hypothetical teaching example. No footage was generated for it.
